svg.text: Data sources by feature — T9 simulator
LU2, B4, B5, B6, LU6, C4, LA1, LC1
LU3, B2, LU6, C4, LA1, E1
LU2–LU6, B2, B4–B6, C4, LA1, LC1, LC2
IP iPinYou — empirical distribution shapes & anchors
BM Benchmark config — external US-2025 reports (StatCounter, Sensor Tower / Newzoo, IAB, mediation reports, AppsFlyer / Liftoff …)
IN Inferred config — set by documented judgment (flagged INFERRED)
SP Synthetic pool — Stage-1 generation: synthetic ids + latent draws
CP Computed — calculated from the feature columns listed on the right (Stage-2 formulas + random draws)
D2 = hour_of_day extracted from D1 timestamp
D3 = day_of_week extracted from D1 timestamp
E1 ~ Bernoulli( base_ctr · LU2 · v_slot · m(r) · LA1 · LC1 )
E2 = D1 + Exponential(λ_click) offset [0 if E1=0]
F1 ~ Bernoulli( base_ir · LU3 · ease(B2) · m(r) · LA1 ) [0 if E1=0]
F2 = E2 + Exponential(λ_install) offset [0 if F1=0]
G1 ~ Bernoulli( LU4 · m(r) ) [0 if F1=0]
G2 = LogNormal(μ_cat, σ) · LU5 · LC2 [μ_cat = lognormal_μ + ln(ltv_mult(B2)); 0 if G1=0]
H2 = k_cpa(C2) · v_slot · ease(B2) · E[ltv|B2] · LogNormal(0, σ_explore)
H3 = 1 if H2 ≥ max(LU7, H1) else 0
H4 = max(H2, LU7) [H4 absent in C1/C2 — only C3/C4 receive clearing price]
where: m(r) = (1−w_stage) + w_stage·LU6[ad_genre] | v_slot = fmt_wt(B6)·size_wt(B4,B5) | EV = p_click·p_install·p_payer·e_ltv
GROUND TRUTH ESTIMANDS (Section 3 — master dataset only)
p_click = base_ctr · LU2 · v_slot · m(r) · LA1 · LC1
p_install= base_ir · LU3 · ease(B2) · m(r) · LA1
e_ltv = exp(μ_cat) · LU5 · LC2 · ρ(A3) [ρ(iOS)≈1.8×; μ_cat = lognormal_μ + ln(ltv_mult(B2))]
Notes: A3–A5 = US mobile config targets (StatCounter, BM). B4/B5 = IAB standard sizes (BM) with inferred distribution (IN). B6 slot_format = inferred from IAB taxonomy (IN).
E/F/G rows: observed on ALL rows in C2/C4 (MMP data); on won rows only in C1/C3 (no MMP — censored by auction outcome). H4 clearing_price: C3/C4 only (SSP data).
Latent row shading: lavender=USER, green=APP, orange=CAMPAIGN, blue=AUCTION. Estimand rows shaded lavender. 'Calculated from' lists input COLUMNS only; config constants and draw seeds omitted.
